conditions.driver_tip_in_procedure: Apply 10-20% throttle for 0.5-1.0s out of coast before committing to 100% WOT

stop_conditions: Wideband lambda > 0.82 (> 12.0 AFR) under boost > 8 psi
Boost spike > 15.5 psi (approaching 16 psi SCG-1 cut)
Engine stall or severe undershoot (< 700 RPM) on clutch-in
Engine coolant temp > 220 F or rapid thermal spike
